source:
@@U04641@@
And you, you flailing, gangly buffoons,
keep your arms astir over the body,
so if it escapes you'll catch it in your claws.
I suspect it’s growing tired of its old quarters,
and spirits always seek the upward path.

@@U04642@@
(A glory is lowered from above right in a burst of light.)

@@U04644@@
Kin to the blest above,
Envoys of heavenly love,
Follow in flight:
Sinners forgiving
Bounteous giving
To all things living,
A trace of delight!

@@U04646@@
Ah!
These jarring, jangling discords!
Sounds, terrible, falling from the sky,
unwelcome, ah!
unwelcome as that hated light!
Androgynous bungling!
Boyish-girlish pranks that
only the godly can abide!
You know how in the depths of black depravity
we planned the annihilation of the human race?
Well, in creating the gravest of all sins,
we found that they were welcome in their worship.
Hypocrites! Mincing milksops!
They rob our prey using our own weapons!
Devils, they're devils, too, the same as us!
Ah, but disguised!
If they get the better of you,
you never live it down!
Stand fast at the grave!
Hold it against all odds!
translation:
@@U04641@@
而你，你这些挥舞着的、瘦长的小丑，
保持双臂在身体上方搅动，
所以如果它逃跑了，你就会用爪子抓住它。
我怀疑它已经厌倦了它的老地方，
精神总是寻求向上的道路。

@@U04642@@
（一道光辉从右上方降下。）

@@U04644@@
与上面的祝福有关，
天上爱的使者，
飞行中跟随：
罪人宽恕
慷慨的给予
对一切有生命的事物，
一丝欣喜！

@@U04646@@
啊！
这些刺耳的、刺耳的不和谐声！
从天而降的声音，可怕，
不受欢迎啊！
不受欢迎，就像那讨厌的光一样！
雌雄同体的笨拙！
男孩女孩般的恶作剧
只有敬虔的人才能忍受！
你知道在黑色堕落的深处如何
我们策划了人类的灭绝？
嗯，在创造了所有罪孽中最严重的时候，
我们发现他们的崇拜受到欢迎。
伪君子！切碎奶泡！
他们用我们自己的武器抢劫我们的猎物！
恶魔，他们也是恶魔，和我们一样！
啊，不过是伪装的！
如果他们比你更好
你永远不会失望！
坟墓前要坚守！
克服一切困难坚持下去！
